questions.s:
A laboratory has a powdered mixture of solid iodine and solid carbon.

o: P is distilled and the distillate is evaporated to dryness.
P is filtered and the filtrate is allowed to evaporate to dryness.

Q is distilled and the distillate is evaporated to dryness.
